about: What each UI test does on a device, listed by scripts/test_ios_ui.sh --dry-run for approval (artifact/topics/ios-c-abi-2, UI automation design v4, 4.6). systemui: presses system alerts or the springboard. sharesheet: opens the share sheet (closes it without choosing). clipboard: writes a named pasteboard only. reinstall: the harness is removed and installed again before the test. playertests: runs the iOS player tests of scripts/verify_unity_ios.sh (a named pasteboard round trip; reads the notification permission without asking). The entry PlayerTests/IosPlayer is that run; scripts/test_ios_ui.sh never selects it.
